This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER
Petitioners have filed this petition under Section 482 read with Section 407 of Cr.P.C. for transferring the criminal case No. 4752/2017 pending before the JMFC, Guna.
Petitioners have further challenged the order dated 1/6/2023 passed by the Sessions Judge, Gunawhereby the application for transferring the aforesaid proceedings has been dismissed.

It is the submission of learned counsel for the petitioners that an FIR was registered against the petitioners by complainant vide crime No. 663/2015 for offence under Section 306, 406, 75, 420 of IPC.
Upon filing a petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. before this Court, same was partly allowed and charge of offence under Section 306 of IPC against the petitioners quashed.

It is submitted that complainant in the matter is the Court Munsi in the same Court and therefore, petitioners have Laxmi Bai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72417614/
1 prayed for transfer of the matter, which has been turned down.

sentences.text: Petitioners challenged the said order before the Sessions Judge, however, met with the same result.

It is the submission of petitioners that without considering the grounds raised by the petitioners, Court below passed the order in a slipshod manner, hence, same is not sustainable in the eyes of law.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State supported the impugned order and prayed for dismissal of the petition.
Heard.

Considering the over all facts and circumstances of the case as well as the nature of allegation levelled by the petitioners, petitioners are given one more opportunity to move before the Sessions Court and Sessions Court on its turn is directed to reconsider the application of petitioners considering all the allegations including the grounds as raised in this petition including Section 407 of Cr.P.C. and decide the same in accordance with law on its own merits without being influenced by the observations made hereinabove.
Petition stands disposed of with the aforesaid observations.
(ROOPESH CHANDRA VARSHNEY) JUDGE JPS/- Digitally signed by JAI PRAKASH SOLANKI DN: c=IN, o=HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH BENCH JAI PRAKASH GWALIOR,
